verdict.rationale: LocalAI runs as an HTTP server with an OpenAI-compatible API, published on port 8080 in the Docker quickstart. Multi-user auth with per-user API keys and OAuth strongly implies other clients reach it over the network. However, the docs only show `localhost:8080` and never explicitly document binding to a LAN address or connecting from other devices. Missing for 10: explicit docs on listen/bind address configuration for LAN exposure, a documented walkthrough of access from other devices, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices

citations.quote: One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
Run with `LOCALAI_AUTH=true` for multi-user support with admin/user roles, OAuth login, per-user API keys, and usage tracking.
LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
